  "Primary excision with a narrow (1-3mm) margin is recommended when melanoma is suspected to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies may be performed on large lesions such as facial lentigo maligna, acral lesions, and genital lesions.",
  "Consensus rate for the primary excision recommendation is 100% (21/21).",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be determined based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible."
